name: Anwen
greeting: There. Close enough that he need not ask again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A hand comes beneath the screen. It steadies the cup against the wood before lifting it.

lines: Kael: Was he with the missing cart?
Anwen: No. A fall on the south road. Not every hurt here is a sign, Kael. Some people only need water.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cup comes back to the linen. For a moment, the breathing behind the screen is easier.
